text: The purpose of this report is to appoint a director to the Mount Dennis BIA board of management and remove directors from the Mount Dennis, shoptheQueensway.com and Weston Village BIA boards of management.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominee to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) board of management set out below at the pleasure of Etobicoke York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Mount Dennis: Singh, Aaina 2. Removed the following directors from the Business Improvement Area (BIA) boards of management set out below: Mount Dennis: Elsaigh, Amru Iyengar, Srinivasan shoptheQueensway.com: Baistrocchi, Karen Hafizi, Sohail Hee-Karstadt, Lilian Weston Village: Hatherley, Marianne
